items.title: A2MEND
items.description: Mentorship, leadership development, and academic support focused on the success of African American men.

items.title: Accelerate Program for Adult Learners
items.description: A learning community for new and returning adult learners that offers linked courses, academic support, and peer connection.

items.title: Admissions & Records
items.description: Help with enrollment, registration, transcripts, residency questions, and official student records.

items.title: Basic Needs Program
items.description: Resources for food, housing, transportation, emergency support, and other essentials that help you stay focused on school.

items.title: Black Student Success Center
items.description: A welcoming space centered on the success of Black students, offering community, academic resources, and culturally affirming support.

items.title: CalWORKs
items.description: Education and career support for eligible student parents receiving public assistance, helping balance school, work, and family life.

items.title: Campus Printing
items.description: Easy, low-cost printing options for class materials and assignments across campus.

items.title: Career Center
items.description: Career exploration, job search support, and internship resources to help you prepare for what comes next.

items.title: Counseling
items.description: Academic counseling to help you plan classes, set goals, and stay on track toward graduation, transfer, or career pathways.

items.title: DESTINO Program
items.description: A STEM-focused program supporting Latino/a/x students with academic guidance, community, and preparation for transfer.

items.title: Disabled Student Services
items.description: Accommodations, advocacy, and services that ensure students with disabilities have equal access to education.

items.title: DREAM Services
items.description: A safe and welcoming space offering guidance, resources, and community for undocumented and Dreamer students.

items.title: EOPS
items.description: Comprehensive academic and financial support for eligible students facing educational barriers.

items.title: Financial Aid Office
items.description: Help with paying for college, including FAFSA and CA Dream Act applications, grants, scholarships, loans, and work-study.

items.title: Foster Youth Support Services
items.description: Dedicated guidance and resources to help foster youth succeed academically and personally.

items.title: Health & Wellness
items.description: Medical care, mental health support, and wellness resources designed to support your overall well-being.

items.title: Honors
items.description: An enriched academic experience offering smaller classes, priority registration, and enhanced preparation for transfer.

items.title: International Student Services
items.description: Advising and support for F-1 international students, including immigration guidance, academic resources, and help navigating life at LBCC during your time in the U.S.

items.title: Justice Scholars Program
items.description: A program designed to help justice-impacted students navigate college through counseling, resources, and community.

items.title: LBCC Phoenix Scholars
items.description: A supportive community for gang-impacted youth and young adults, offering counseling, resources, and guidance to help you succeed academically and build a stable path forward.

items.title: Male Success Initiative (MSI)
items.description: A learning community for men of color that provides mentorship, community, and support for academic success.

items.title: MANA - APID Learning Commmunity
items.description: A learning community for Asian, Pacific Islander, and Desi (APID) students that fosters cultural connection, community, and academic success.

items.title: MESA
items.description: A community for students pursuing STEM majors, offering academic support, peer connection, and preparation for transfer to four-year universities.

items.title: North Long Beach Center
items.description: Classes and student services closer to home, providing more convenient access to LBCC for North Long Beach residents.

items.title: Pride Scholars - LGBGTQIA+ Learning Community
items.description: A learning community for LGBTQIA+ students and allies that fosters belonging, cultural awareness, and academic success.

items.title: Probation Counseling
items.description: Guidance for students on academic probation, helping you regroup, plan next steps, and work toward academic recovery.

items.title: PUENTE - Latinx Learning Community
items.description: A learning community for Latino/a/x students that builds community while supporting academic, career, and transfer goals.

items.title: Student Parenting Hub
items.description: A central hub for student parents, connecting you to childcare support, resources, and a community that understands your priorities

items.title: Student Services Division
items.description: The division that connects and coordinates many of the programs and services supporting your success at LBCC.

items.title: Student Success Centers
items.description: Subject-specific spaces where you can get tutoring, guidance, and support connected directly to your major.

items.title: Student Tech Help Desk
items.description: Help with Canvas, student email, Wi-Fi, and other technology you rely on for classes—available online or in person.

items.title: Transfer Center
items.description: Advising, workshops, and application support to help you prepare for transfer to CSU, UC, or private universities.

items.title: TRIO GO Project
items.description: Academic advising, transfer preparation, and personal development for first-generation and low-income students.

items.title: Tutoring & Academic Resources
items.description: Free tutoring and learning resources to help you understand course material, prepare for exams, and build strong study habits.

items.title: UMOJA - Black Learning Community
items.description: A learning community for Black and African American students that promotes cultural connection, community, and academic success.

items.title: Upward Bound
items.description: College readiness support for high school students through academic enrichment, mentoring, and guidance.

items.title: Veterans Services
items.description: A dedicated space offering education benefits guidance, advising, and community for veterans and military-affiliated students.

items.title: Welcome Center
items.description: The starting point for new students, where you can get oriented, ask questions, and connect to the right next steps.
